raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
This PR is part of a stack (oldest at bottom):

* #42936
* #42898
* #42897
* #42896
* #42895
* #42894
* #42893
* #42892
* __->__ #42891

## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4 runs its own two-batch-overlap layer loop (`DeepseekV4Model._forward_layers_tbo`), and its layers carry no residual between them, so each microbatch's output has `residual=None`. Since #42307, the shared `_model_forward_tbo_merge_outputs` reads both outputs' residual as a `ResidualStream`, so DeepSeek-V4 prefill with `--enable-two-batch-overlap` fails at the first merge:

```
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'pending'
```

The AMD nightly `test_deepseek_v4_flash_fp8_tbo.py` fails with this error; there is no NVIDIA test for DeepSeek-V4 two-batch overlap.

## Modifications

- Move the token-range concatenation into `_model_forward_tbo_merge_key(output_a, output_b, name, original_len)`. DeepSeek-V4 merges its hidden states with it directly; the stream-carrying merge keeps its single caller, `model_forward_stages`. The old path only completed an owed sum on DeepSeek-V4's output, and `hc_post` returns a plain tensor, so dropping it changes no value.
- Add the NVIDIA counterpart of the AMD nightly: `test_deepseek_v4_flash_fp4_b200_tbo.py` (registry `nightly-4-gpu-b200`) launches DeepSeek-V4-Flash with TP 4, attention DP 4, DeepEP and `--enable-two-batch-overlap`, gated on GSM8K ≥ 0.93.

## Accuracy Tests

- The 13 two-batch-overlap and DeepSeek-V4 unit test files give the same results on `main` and with this change.
- 4× B200, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731`, launched as the new nightly test does:
  - `main` (`6cc661f223`, and again at `a34cba3c62`): the first two-batch-overlap prefill raises the `AttributeError`.
  - This change on `6cc661f223`: the nightly test passes with GSM8K 0.970. Each of the 4 DP ranks enters and merges the overlapped layer loop 8 times, on prefills of up to 3,907 tokens.
  - The top of this stack on `main` `a34cba3c62`, 200-question 5-shot GSM8K: 0.960 and 0.960 with two-batch overlap (two launches). `main` `a34cba3c62` without two-batch overlap scores 0.970.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the path crashed before, and the merge performs the same concatenation.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+"""B200 nightly CI: DeepSeek-V4-Flash FP4 with two-batch overlap.
+
+Launches TP=4, DP attention 4 and DeepEP with --enable-two-batch-overlap, so
+prefill runs DeepSeek-V4's own two-batch-overlap layer loop. Runs a GSM8K
+accuracy gate.
+
+Registry: nightly-4-gpu-b200 (nightly, 4x B200)
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.eval_accuracy_kit import GSM8KMixin
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    try_cached_model,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=600, stage="nightly", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+MODEL = "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731"
+SERVER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT = 3600
+DEEPEP_CONFIG = '{"normal_dispatch":{"num_sms":96},"normal_combine":{"num_sms":96}}'
+
+
+class TestDSV4FlashFP4TboB200(GSM8KMixin, CustomTestCase):
+    gsm8k_accuracy_thres = 0.93
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.model = try_cached_model(MODEL)
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=SERVER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT,
+            other_args=[
+                "--trust-remote-code",
+                "--tp",
+                "4",
+                "--attn-dp-size",
+                "4",
+                "--moe-a2a-backend",
+                "deepep",
+                "--deepep-config",
+                DEEPEP_CONFIG,
+                "--enable-two-batch-overlap",
+            ],
+            env={"SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK": "1024"},
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        if hasattr(cls, "process") and cls.process:
+            kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
